Test archives from the rarfile project (https://github.com/markokr/rarfile,
test/files), by Marko Kreen, under the ISC licence in LICENSE beside them.
Copied unchanged on 2026-11-03 for HolyArrs' RAR 4 tests:

- rar3-old.rar, rar3-old.r00, rar3-old.r01: a stored (method 0) set over
  three volumes with the old .rar/.r00 naming. rar3-old.rar.exp is the
  project's listing of it.
- rar3-solid.rar: a compressed (method 3), solid RAR 2.9 archive with two
  files. rar3-solid.rar.exp is the project's listing of it.
